title: GEODATA host-block soft-pointer remapping
scope: Correct the low-level DXF GEODATA writer's group-330 host-block reference handling.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
authority.field: H — soft pointer to host block (model space layout owner block)

implementation.behavior: writeGeoData now serializes m_hostBlockHandle through remapObjectHandle. A source or mapped null/sentinel handle is refused before the GEODATA record scope publishes bytes.
implementation.compatibility: The DRW_GeoData public layout and interface are unchanged; a zero host handle continues to omit the optional group.

regression_control.behavior: The GEODATA writer vector verifies remapped group-330 host handle and typed ASCII/Binary readback, caller-handle preservation, null mapping atomic refusal, and corrected same-writer retry.

validation.test_result: updated GEODATA assertions emitted no failures; the aggregate Wave 1 test failed with 68 assertions in unrelated UNDERLAYDEFINITION, common-object metadata/reference, XDATA ordering, and record-identity inventory controls.

limits: This proves generated low-level DXF transport only; it does not establish physical DWG producer breadth or native geospatial unit/projection semantics.
dwg2dxf still has no typed GEODATA callback retention/output route or complete source CLASS, owner, host-block dependency, and fresh output-readback proof.
